name: Slotbound
built: A roguelite auto-battler where a 3x3 slot machine summons your army, made by a solo first-time developer with no prior coding experience.
results: Dashboard shown $356,028 in gross Steam revenue ($313,764 net) and 50,221 Steam units in its first 48 hours; developer later posted nearly $1.33M gross in the first week and 100,000+ copies sold (self-reported on X, Nov 2026).
steal: Build the full game loop with AI coding tools while you focus on design, balance and polish. Ship a polished demo early for wishlists, then iterate on player feedback after launch. One solo non-coder did the entire code and most assets with Cursor, Codex, Claude and ChatGPT.
